Pg. 28. Handwritten Continued notes from Page 27 and Conclusion of Retreat Notes.
Just finishing said 20 decades on the threshold of our destination (Huntington), a quite remarkable lightening - flash showed us we were in town; and Fr. S. feeling he'd have time to remark, while the sound was coming, Exclaimed: "Thank God, what a wonderful tripl and the - peal thundered as from Heaven a mighty "Amen"!
We were past the right road and like out in the field whence we saw the Monastery lit up through the rain ...... We arrived at 7:55 receiving "Benedicte" and bell rang for first "retreat conference". Deo Gr. !
Pg. 29. Handwritten Retreat Notes 1941 Oct. 5th % Fr. Edgar, O.F.M. Cap . .. Pittsburgh .... Sunday 8 P.M. ... True Sons of St. Francis

I. "This is the will of God, Your Sanctification". Keeping the rule ... the means of = P.M. "Blessed are the clean of Heart, for ...
7th
I. POVERTY "We lived in poor and deserted little houses ..... Con'ted with Holy Rule . and wanted noth' more."
II. Fraternal Charity .... "If a mother loves her son according to the flesh how much more H. Rule
III. Appreciation for the Cross-of being Christ-like. "For me to live is Christ. to die is gain.
Iv. Privileg of laboring in Community ... "I labored with my hands ... . and most earnestly do I desire that all my brethren .... work.
Oct. 8
I. Mortal Sin. "They that sin and work iniquity are enemies of their own souls."
II. "Fear of the Lord driveth out sin; and be that is without fear cannot be justified."
III. Vigilence ... "Fratres sobrii estote .... Oct. 9
I. "See to it that nothing hinder thee from praying always."
II. "Behold I am with you all days ...
